data.gender_notes: Earlie is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from Old English ‘eoran’, meaning ‘earth’ or ‘early’. The name Earlie is often used to denote an early arrival or an early leader. In Christian tradition, it may symbolize being among the first to accept or follow a new teaching or spiritual path. The name Earlie carries the meaning “Early, foremost” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English. Parents who choose Earlie usually hope their child will grow to embody early, foremost and live with faith, good character and purpose.
